exactCueCheck: function cueCheck(row,strong){if(active.name==='C-cue'){if(strong===null)assert.equal(row.cue.present,false,'Consumed/terminal candidate cue still present');else{assert.equal(row.cue.strong,strong);assert.equal(row.cue.visible,true);}}else assert.equal(row.cue.present,false,'Retained turn1-only cue unexpectedly present in turn2');}
